# Main analyses

Here we perform the polygenic score analyses. We first load the prepared RNAseq data, and extract only the relevant genes. We then calculate a polygenic score from the target genes. 

## Targets

Here we obtain data from the `r TRAIT_OF_INTEREST` in plaques.

```{r targets, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(openxlsx)

gene_list_df <- read.xlsx(paste0(PROJECT_loc, "/targets/targets.xlsx"), sheet = "Genes")

gene_list <- unlist(gene_list_df$Gene)
gene_list

```

# Create polygenic score

Here we create a polygenic score consisting of the variance weighted averages of the target genes. 

```{r}
library(SummarizedExperiment)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)

# Extract expression data from SummarizedExperiment
expression_data <- assay(AERNASE.targets)

# Ensure gene_list_qc is a character vector
gene_list_qc <- as.character(gene_list_qc)

# Subset expression data for the target genes
expression_subset <- expression_data[rownames(expression_data) %in% gene_list_qc, , drop = FALSE]

# Check for missing genes
missing_genes <- setdiff(gene_list_qc, rownames(expression_subset))
if (length(missing_genes) > 0) {
  message("Warning: The following genes were not found in the dataset: ", paste(missing_genes, collapse = ", "))
}

# Compute variance for each gene across individuals (rows)
gene_variance <- apply(expression_subset, 1, var, na.rm = TRUE)

# Normalize weights so they sum to 1
weights <- gene_variance / sum(gene_variance, na.rm = TRUE)

# Ensure weight vector matches number of selected genes
if (length(weights) != nrow(expression_subset)) {
  stop("Error: Weight vector length does not match the number of genes in the expression matrix.")
}

# Compute the variance-weighted polygenic score for each individual
weighted_score <- colSums(expression_subset * weights, na.rm = TRUE)

# Compute the unweighted polygenic score (mean expression per individual)
unweighted_score <- colMeans(expression_subset, na.rm = TRUE)

# Convert scores to a data frame
score_df <- data.frame(
  study_number = colnames(expression_subset),  # Match individuals (columns in expression data)
  weighted_score = weighted_score,  # Variance-weighted score
  unweighted_score = unweighted_score  # Unweighted mean expression score
)

# Extract phenotype data from SummarizedExperiment (assumed in colData)
phenotype_data <- as.data.frame(colData(AERNASE.targets)) %>%
  dplyr::select(study_number, Fat.bin_10, SMC.bin, IPH.bin, Plaque_Vulnerability_Index)

# Merge phenotype data with scores
expression_phenotype <- inner_join(phenotype_data, score_df, by = "study_number")

# Add a factor for Plaque Vulnerability Index (PVI)
expression_phenotype$PVI_factor <- factor(expression_phenotype$Plaque_Vulnerability_Index, levels = as.character(0:5))
```

# Analysis and visualization of polygenic score

Here we perform some basic analyses and visualizations of the polygenic score.

```{r}
library(ggpubr)
library(dplyr)

# Convert categorical plaque phenotype variables into numeric
expression_phenotype <- expression_phenotype %>%
  mutate(
    Fat.bin_10 = as.numeric(factor(Fat.bin_10, levels = c(" <10%", " >10%"))),
    SMC.bin = as.numeric(factor(SMC.bin, levels = c("no/minor", "moderate/heavy"))),
    IPH.bin = as.numeric(factor(IPH.bin, levels = c("no", "yes"))),
    Plaque_Vulnerability_Index = as.numeric(Plaque_Vulnerability_Index)
  )

```


Compute correlations.

```{r}
# Compute Spearman correlation
cor_results <- cor(expression_phenotype[, c("weighted_score", "unweighted_score", "Fat.bin_10", "SMC.bin", "IPH.bin", "Plaque_Vulnerability_Index")], 
                   use = "pairwise.complete.obs", method = "spearman")

# Print correlation results
cor_results

# Export correlation results to a CSV file
write.csv(cor_results, file = paste0(PROJECT_loc, "/", Today, ".", PROJECTNAME, ".polygenicscore_correlation_results.csv"))
```

Let's visualize the correlations in a heatmap.

```{r}
library(pheatmap)
library(Hmisc)  # For rcorr() to get p-values

# Compute Spearman correlation with p-values
cor_results <- rcorr(as.matrix(expression_phenotype[, c("weighted_score", "unweighted_score", "Fat.bin_10", "SMC.bin", "IPH.bin", "Plaque_Vulnerability_Index")]), 
                     type = "spearman")

cor_matrix <- cor_results$r  # Extract correlation coefficients
p_matrix <- cor_results$P  # Extract p-values

# Rename variables and reorder rows/columns
new_names <- c("Fat", "SMCs", "IPH", "PVI", "Polygenic Score", "Unweighted Polygenic Score")

# Reorder the correlation matrix
cor_matrix <- cor_matrix[c("Fat.bin_10", "SMC.bin", "IPH.bin", "Plaque_Vulnerability_Index", "weighted_score", "unweighted_score"),
                         c("Fat.bin_10", "SMC.bin", "IPH.bin", "Plaque_Vulnerability_Index", "weighted_score", "unweighted_score")]

p_matrix <- p_matrix[c("Fat.bin_10", "SMC.bin", "IPH.bin", "Plaque_Vulnerability_Index", "weighted_score", "unweighted_score"),
                     c("Fat.bin_10", "SMC.bin", "IPH.bin", "Plaque_Vulnerability_Index", "weighted_score", "unweighted_score")]

# Apply new names
rownames(cor_matrix) <- new_names
colnames(cor_matrix) <- new_names

rownames(p_matrix) <- new_names
colnames(p_matrix) <- new_names

# Function to map p-values to asterisks
significance_levels <- function(p) {
  ifelse(p < 0.001, "***",
         ifelse(p < 0.01, "**",
                ifelse(p < 0.05, "*", "")))
}

# Generate asterisks for p-values
p_asterisks <- matrix(significance_levels(p_matrix), nrow = nrow(p_matrix), ncol = ncol(p_matrix))

# Remove diagonal values (set to empty string "")
diag(p_asterisks) <- ""

rownames(p_asterisks) <- new_names
colnames(p_asterisks) <- new_names

# Create the heatmap with asterisks
p <- pheatmap(cor_matrix, 
              cluster_rows = FALSE,
              cluster_cols = FALSE,
              color = colorRampPalette(c("blue", "white", "red"))(100), 
              fontsize = 12, 
              main = "Polygenic Score Correlation Heatmap",
              display_numbers = p_asterisks,  # Add asterisks for p-values
              number_color = "black")

# Save as PNG and PDF
ggsave(filename = paste0(PROJECT_loc, "/", Today, ".", PROJECTNAME, ".polygenicscore_correlation_heatmap.png"), 
       plot = p[[4]], width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)

ggsave(filename = paste0(PROJECT_loc, "/", Today, ".", PROJECTNAME, ".polygenicscore_correlation_heatmap.pdf"), 
       plot = p[[4]], width = 8, height = 6)

# Cleanup
rm(p)
```



```{r}
library(ggpubr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggsci)

# Compute max value for better label placement
max_y <- max(expression_phenotype$weighted_score, na.rm = TRUE)

# Boxplot for binary traits (Fat, SMCs, IPH)
p1 <- ggboxplot(expression_phenotype %>% drop_na(Fat.bin_10, weighted_score), x = "Fat.bin_10", y = "unweighted_score",
                add = "jitter", color = "Fat.bin_10", palette = "npg", repel = TRUE) +
  stat_compare_means(method = "wilcox.test") +  
  labs(title = "Polygenic Score vs Fat", x = "Fat", y = "Polygenic Score") +
  theme_minimal()
p1
```

```{r}
# Define NPG colors manually
npg_colors <- c("#E64B35", "#4DBBD5", "#00A087", "#3C5488", "#F39B7F", "#8491B4")

# Remove NA values
data_clean <- expression_phenotype %>% drop_na(PVI_factor, unweighted_score)

# Convert factor to numeric for regression
data_clean$PVI_numeric <- as.numeric(data_clean$PVI_factor)

# Perform linear regression
lm_model <- lm(weighted_score ~ PVI_numeric, data = data_clean)
summary_lm <- summary(lm_model)

# Extract regression coefficient (β) and p-value
beta <- round(summary_lm$coefficients[2, 1], 3)  # Slope
p_value <- summary_lm$coefficients[2, 4]  # p-value

# Format p-value for display
p_text <- ifelse(p_value < 0.001, "p < 0.001", paste0("p = ", round(p_value, 3)))

# Create plot
p4 <- ggplot(data_clean, aes(x = PVI_numeric, y = weighted_score, color = PVI_factor)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +  # Scatter points
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "black", aes(group = 1), linetype = "dashed") +  # Dotted regression line
  scale_color_manual(values = npg_colors) +  # Use manually defined NPG colors
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:length(levels(expression_phenotype$PVI_factor)),  # Ensure correct axis labels
                     labels = levels(expression_phenotype$PVI_factor)) +
  labs(title = "Polygenic Score vs PVI", x = "PVI", y = "Polygenic Score", color = "PVI") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "white")) +  # White legend background
  annotate("text", x = max(data_clean$PVI_numeric) - 1, y = max(data_clean$weighted_score), 
           label = paste0("β = ", beta, ", ", p_text), 
           hjust = 1, size = 4, fontface = "bold")  # Add regression coefficient and p-value

p4  # Print the plot
```

Combine the graphs. 

```{r}
# Arrange plots with larger layout
combined_plot <- ggarrange(p1, p2, p3, p4, ncol = 2, nrow = 2, align = "hv", heights = c(1, 1.1))
combined_plot
```
